title: Group HH custom process-unit spec (unit_spec.json)
description:
The single source of truth from which every artifact (workbook, plant instance/class, model-base fork, icon) is generated and against which every check in the seven-rung ladder runs. A prose description is never accepted silently: it becomes a spec here, and the human reviews and corrects it before anything is emitted. This is a DRAFT proposal for human approval (ticket 05); the linter's full bidirectional invariants live in ticket 09's code, not only in this JSON Schema.

Governance carried as first-class structure:
- The REQUIRED sentinel is the literal string "REQUIRED" inside a coefficient's 'value' — an explicit unfilled value, never an absent key.
- Every coefficient carries 'provenance' from the closed enum {user-measured, user-stated, literature-cited, inherited-model-base}.
- Routing, composite classification, balance exemptions, and per-process inherited parameters are data, not behaviour — the linter enforces their consistency with the rest of the spec.
- Volatile fields (timestamps, content_hash) are excluded from the content hash; hashing reuses the discipline in PY/pipeline/hashing.py (sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema contract. Bump only with a coordinated tool/linter change.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex over the spec with volatile fields removed (routing.routing_confirmed_at, provenance.created, provenance.modified, and this field itself). Computed with PY/pipeline/hashing.py hash_json discipline (sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False). Not required — tooling computes and stamps it.

identity.description: Naming/versioning contract from ticket 15. 'name' + 'version' constitute identity; everything else is content. Changing content increments 'version'; changing 'name' creates a different unit.

name.description: Bare human name, no prefix, no version suffix.

qualified_name.description: HH_<name>_v<n>. Generated, never user-set. The value used in the workbook, folder name, and plant instance.

version.description: Incremented on each regeneration from a corrected spec; never overwrite (ticket 15).

supersedes.description: qualified_name of the previous version, or null for v1. Enables version-to-plant traceability (ticket 18).

description.description: One-paragraph human summary of what the unit does.

routing.description: Type A/B classification (ticket 19). Routing is data, not behaviour: the linter enforces consistency with the spec's contents in both directions. Never guessed — refuse and ask on ambiguity.

routed_as.description: A = new topology/transport unit reusing the existing model base. B = new biology/chemistry with new state variables and Gujer rows (a forked model base).

routing_evidence.description: The described processes, variables, or phrases that forced the classification (ticket 19).

routing_confirmed_by_user.description: True only after the user explicitly confirmed the routing during a disambiguation exchange.

routing_confirmed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of user confirmation, null if never confirmed. Volatile — excluded from content_hash.

classification.description: Composite detection (ticket 17). Composites are OUT of cycle 1 with a detecting refusal. The spec carries is_composite + composite_evidence, and NO component list, NO internal connections, NO external port mapping.

is_composite.description: True when the description decomposes into several coupled process units. The linter REFUSES is_composite=true in cycle 1, naming the sub-units and couplings, and stating what would be accepted.

model_binding.description: Which biokinetic models the unit declares valid/invalid, and for Type B, the forked custom model base it requires (ticket 04).

models.description: Model identifiers (local names). First-listed is the default for shorthand expansion; a custom base should list its ID first (ticket 04).

model_base.description: Present and object for Type B; null/absent for Type A. The fork declaration only — the actual additions (new SVs, processes, kinetic parameters) live in the top-level state_variables/processes/parameters sections so each coefficient has exactly one home.

ports.description: The Port table contract (ticket 02b). Each port optionally declares which balances it conserves and which it is exempt from (amendment 3) — ticket 07 reads this.

attributes.description: Unit-sheet Attribute table. Structural flags/constants, not physical coefficients; their 'default' is not provenance-stamped (see OPEN QUESTIONS).

parameters.description: The Parameters-sheet contract (ticket 02b). 'type' distinguishes unit-level parameters from kinetic/stoichiometric/equilibrium parameters, which are Type-B model-base additions. Every 'default' carries provenance.

state_variables.description: State variables. 'introduced' are new (Type B) and MUST carry an elemental/ionic formula (amendment 5) — the composition ticket 06 recomputes COD/N/P/charge from. 'referenced' are drawn from the model base (Type A and Type B alike).

processes.description: The Gujer matrix in spec form: one entry per process (a row on the model-base Model sheet). Empty for Type A (the base supplies the matrix); non-empty for Type B. Each stoichiometric coefficient carries provenance, and each process lists its inherited parameters (amendment 2).

code_blocks.description: The Code-sheet contract (ticket 03b). codelocation is closed to the cycle-1 allow-list; anything else (Event, Accumulated, DataComm, Integrated, C++ code, SolverConfiguration) is a documented refusal, never a silent mis-emit.

gui.description: GUI-visibility contract (ticket 14). Not read by the SMT or compiler, but required for a usable drawing-board unit; the emitter writes it and a dedicated lint rung checks it.

popup.description: Hover tooltip variable list (optional but recommended).

provenance.description: Authoring metadata and machine stamps. 'created'/'modified' are volatile and excluded from content_hash.

created.description: ISO-8601, set once at first authoring.

authoring_tool.description: Which entry point produced the spec: 'describe_<unit>' (prose) or 'define_<unit>' (structured).

literature_opt_in.description: True when the user opted in to literature-value proposal (ticket Q5).

machine_stamp.description: Type B: 'stoichiometry-verified, kinetically-unverified' until the degenerate-equivalence run executes (Q14 teeth item 3).

by.description: Who accepted. UNAUTHENTICATED free text - a record, not an identity check.

confirmation.description: Whether each magnitude was confirmed individually or all at once. 'bulk' requires an explicit opt-in at emission.

confirmed.description: path -> fingerprint of value+provenance+source+unit at acceptance. Any later edit breaks the match and revokes emission.

accepted.description: Explicit human acceptance (ticket 08). Emission refuses without it. ADDED after building the tools revealed that an ACCEPTED spec failed validation - provenance is additionalProperties:false and had no slot for it.

$comment.description: Free-text annotation. Standard JSON Schema annotation keyword; permitted at the top level so fixtures and hand-written specs can carry a note without tripping additionalProperties:false.

allOf.description: routed_as: A forbids a model-base delta; routed_as: B requires one. Full bidirectional consistency (non-empty introduced/processes for B, formula on every introduced SV) is enforced by the linter and stated here as the contract.

provenance.description: Closed source enumeration (amendment 1). 'user-measured' = a value the user obtained by measurement. 'user-stated' = a value the user asserts without a measurement. 'literature-cited' = proposed behind the literature opt-in, with a 'source'. 'inherited-model-base' = pulled from a model base (must also appear in the process's inherited_parameters list).

required_sentinel.description: The first-class unfilled-value sentinel (Q5). A coefficient whose 'value' equals this fails the linter until replaced. It is a value, never an absent key.

coefficient.description: A value plus its provenance. 'value' is a number, a symbolic/string expression (e.g. '-1/YOHO,VFA,ox'), a named limit sentinel (e.g. 'BigNumber'), or the literal 'REQUIRED' sentinel.

anyOf.description: Symbolic expression ('-1/YOHO,VFA,ox'), named limit sentinel ('BigNumber','MinV','MaxFlow'), or the REQUIRED sentinel.

value.description: A number, the REQUIRED sentinel, or a string. NOTE: JSON Schema cannot CONSTRAIN this to the sentinel, because value must also accept arbitrary symbolic expressions and named limit sentinels. Enforcement of REQUIRED (fail the build until replaced) is a rung-1 LINTER duty, not a schema duty. The required_sentinel $ref above exists so the sentinel is a discoverable, named form rather than a convention buried in prose.

source.description: Citation/reference when provenance is literature-cited; measurement description otherwise.

unverified.description: True when literature-cited or user-stated without a measurement. Rendered by the review gate (ticket 08).

name.description: Balance identity. The COD/C/N/P/Na/K/Ca/Mg/Cl/Fe/Al set matches the model-base balance columns (ticket 04); charge, water, energy are added for the continuity rung.

conserved.description: true = conserved across the port; false = exempt (mass leaves/enters by design).

reason.description: Required in practice when conserved=false (a gas port vents, a catchment adds).

elemental_formula.description: Elemental/ionic composition of a state variable (amendment 5). Ticket 06 recomputes COD/N/P/charge from this and fails on mismatch with any declared composition.

elements.description: Stoichiometric amounts per C-mole basis, e.g. {"C":1,"H":1.75,"O":0.5,"N":0.2,"P":0.02}. Keys are element symbols.

balances.description: Balance-exemption declaration (amendment 3). A port with no entry conserves nothing by default; list the balances it participates in and mark conserved true/false.

type.description: 'unit' = Parameters-sheet entry. 'kinetic'/'stoichiometric'/'equilibrium' = model-base additions (Type B only), mirroring the Rule Type(...) vocabulary.

low_limit.description: Number or named sentinel (BigNumber, MinV, MaxFlow, ...).

state_variable.description: A NEW state variable (Type B). The full Components-sheet row (ticket 04) plus the elemental/ionic formula the continuity rung depends on. Every introduced state variable carries BOTH `formula` (elemental/ionic makeup) and `composition` (declared composition on a stated basis). They are deliberately redundant: rung 2 derives one from the other and fails on mismatch.

from_model.description: Model base the variable is drawn from, e.g. 'Sumo2C'.

process.description: One Gujer row in spec form (ticket 03b/04).

name.description: Human recipe, e.g. 'OHO growth on VFAs, O2'.

stoichiometry.description: One coefficient per component. Each coefficient carries provenance.

inherited_parameters.description: Model-base quantities this process imports (amendment 2). Provenance is inherited-model-base by construction; 'from_model' names the source base so the review gate can flag values calibrated for other processes.

role.description: What the parameter does in this process.

codelocation.description: Closed cycle-1 allow-list (ticket 03b MVS). No Event, Accumulated, DataComm, or Integrated in cycle 1.

valid.description: Model bases this unit may bind to.

model_base.description: The Type-B fork declaration only. The additions themselves live at the top level (state_variables/processes/parameters) so no coefficient is duplicated.

register_in_systemcode.description: Whether the new base must be registered in systemcode.xlsx Model Interfaces/Variables (multi-model plants only, ticket 04).

default_icon.description: Default .emf filename, resolved beside the workbook (ticket 14).

conditional_rows.description: State-conditional icon swaps. Cycle 1 may omit these (ticket 14).

declared_composition.description: The state variable's composition as DECLARED, independent of `formula`. Continuity checking derives composition from `formula` and compares it against this; without an independent declaration the continuity check is self-certifying for new state variables (ticket 06). Non-carbon species (e.g. sulfate {S:1,O:4}) cannot be expressed on a g-per-gCOD basis at all and MUST be declared explicitly rather than derived.

basis.description: Basis the `values` are expressed on. Use 'explicit-not-derivable' for species with no COD (sulfate, nitrate-N as N, mineral ions): the checker then records 'declared, not derivable' instead of attempting a per-COD derivation.

values.description: Element symbol -> composition value on `basis`. Keys must be a subset of the eleven balance elements the vendor checks: COD, C, N, P, Na, K, Ca, Mg, Cl, Fe, Al.
